source: Hand-curated from common kanji errors observed in foreign learners — visual look-alikes (末/未, 待/持/特) and same-reading distinctions (暑い/熱い/厚い, 切る/着る).
notes: The kanji and verbs that foreign learners most often mix up — pairs and small clusters that share a shape, a reading, or both. Each card focuses on ONE kanji or verb and explicitly calls out the confusable(s) in the context note with a memory hook for telling them apart. Covers visual look-alikes (one stroke or radical apart), same-reading distinct-meaning verbs, and reading-rich kanji whose senses split across multiple character forms. Most cards sit at N4-N2; the distinctions matter especially in writing and reading comprehension.

cards.context: Confused with 太 (fat — has a dot in the middle) and 犬 (dog — has a dot in the upper right). Mnemonic: 大 = a person with arms outstretched, no extras. Add a 'belly dot' = 太. Add an 'ear dot' = 犬.
cards.example_sentence: とても大きい家ですね。
cards.example_reading: とても おおきい いえ ですね。

cards.context: Confused with 大 (big — no dot) and 犬 (dog — dot in different position). The middle dot is the 'belly' that makes it fat. 太陽 (sun), 太鼓 (drum) are common compounds.
cards.example_sentence: 太いペンで字を書いた。
cards.example_reading: ふとい ペン で じ を かいた。
cards.example_meaning: I wrote with a thick pen.

cards.context: Confused with 大 (big — no dot) and 太 (fat — dot in middle). The dot on the upper-right is the dog's ear/collar tag. 犬 always has the dot in that specific spot.
cards.example_sentence: 犬を散歩に連れて行く。
cards.example_reading: いぬ を さんぽ に つれていく。
cards.example_meaning: I take the dog for a walk.

cards.context: Confused with 干 (dry) and 午 (noon). 千 has a TILTED short top stroke (like a person leaning). 干 has a STRAIGHT horizontal top.
cards.example_reading: せんえんさつ を だした。

cards.context: Confused with 千 (tilted top) and 午 (the vertical goes through). 干 has straight horizontals — picture a clothesline. 干す means 'hang out to dry.'
cards.example_reading: せんたくもの を ほした。

cards.context: Confused with 牛 (cow — has one extra stroke at the top). 午 is mostly used in compounds: 午前 (morning), 午後 (afternoon), 正午 (noon).
cards.example_sentence: 午後三時に会いましょう。
cards.example_reading: ごご さんじ に あいましょう。

cards.context: Confused with 午 (noon — no top horns). The extra stroke at the top is the cow's HORNS. 牛肉 (beef), 牛乳 (milk), 子牛 (calf).
cards.example_sentence: 牧場でたくさんの牛を見た。
cards.example_reading: ぼくじょう で たくさん の うし を みた。
cards.example_meaning: I saw lots of cows at the ranch.

cards.context: Confused with 未 (not yet). 末: TOP horizontal is LONGER (the 'end' has stretched out fully). 未: BOTTOM horizontal is longer. 週末 (weekend), 月末 (end of month).
cards.example_sentence: 週末は何をしましたか。
cards.example_reading: しゅうまつ は なに を しましたか。
cards.example_meaning: What did you do this weekend?

cards.context: Confused with 末 (end). 未: BOTTOM horizontal is LONGER (still 'growing,' not yet finished). 末: top is longer. 未来 (future), 未完成 (incomplete), 未だに (still not).
cards.example_reading: みらい は よそく できない。

cards.context: Confused with 士 (samurai/scholar). 土: BOTTOM horizontal is LONGER (the ground supports). 士: TOP horizontal is longer (the samurai's broad shoulders).
cards.example_reading: どようび は やすみ です。

cards.context: Confused with 土 (earth). 士: TOP wider (broad shoulders). 土: bottom wider. Appears in titles: 弁護士 (lawyer), 看護師→ here uses 師 instead, but 士 in 博士 (doctor/PhD), 武士 (samurai).
cards.example_reading: はかせ ごう を しゅとく した。

cards.context: Confused with 玉 (jewel/ball). 玉 has a DOT inside (the jewel). 王 is plain. Mnemonic: a king without his jewel is just a king (王); add the jewel = 玉.
cards.example_reading: むかし、 おう が くに を おさめた。
cards.example_meaning: Long ago, the king ruled the country.

cards.context: Confused with 王 (king). 玉 has a DOT (the gem). 王 doesn't. 目玉 (eyeball), 水玉 (polka dot), 100円玉 (100-yen coin).
cards.example_reading: ひゃくえん だま が おちていた。

cards.context: Confused with 入 (enter) and 八 (eight). 人: LEFT stroke comes down through the top, like legs. 入: RIGHT stroke goes over the top. 八: both strokes spread wide apart.
cards.example_reading: あの ひと は だれ ですか。

cards.reading: はい(る)・い(る)・ニュウ
cards.context: Confused with 人 (person) and 八 (eight). 入: the RIGHT stroke crosses OVER the top — like one leg stepping over to enter. 人: left stroke crosses over.
cards.example_sentence: 部屋に入ってください。
cards.example_reading: へや に はいって ください。

cards.context: Confused with 人 (person) and 入 (enter). 八: the two strokes spread apart WITHOUT crossing — like an open fan or a Mt. Fuji shape. Number 8 in Japan is lucky for this 'spreading' shape.
cards.example_sentence: 八時に集合してください。
cards.example_reading: はちじ に しゅうごう して ください。

cards.context: Confused with 本 (book/origin) — 本 has an EXTRA horizontal stroke at the bottom (the root). 木 is the bare tree; 本 is 木 + a root mark showing the 'origin.'
cards.example_reading: にわ に おおきな き が ある。
cards.example_meaning: There's a big tree in the garden.

cards.context: Confused with 木 (tree). 本 has an EXTRA horizontal at the trunk's base — marking the ROOT (= origin). The kanji originally meant 'root of a tree' → 'origin' → 'book' (origin of knowledge).
cards.example_reading: としょかん で ほん を かりた。
cards.example_meaning: I borrowed a book from the library.

cards.context: Confused with 石 (stone). 右: the bottom part is 口 (mouth) — say 'right.' 石: the bottom is BIGGER 口 with an extra slant on top, suggesting a rock formation. Differ at the lower-left stroke direction too.
cards.example_sentence: 次の交差点を右に曲がってください。
cards.example_reading: つぎ の こうさてん を みぎ に まがって ください。
cards.example_meaning: Please turn right at the next intersection.

cards.context: Confused with 右 (right). 石: top has a SLANT before the 口 — like a rock resting on its edge. 右: the top has a small horizontal. 石田 (Ishida) is a common surname.
cards.example_reading: かわら で いし を ひろった。
cards.example_meaning: I picked up a stone at the riverbank.

cards.context: Confused with 友 (friend). 左: the bottom is 工 (work) — left hand for craft work. 友: the bottom is 又 (a hand) — friends shake hands.
cards.example_sentence: 左側に駐車してください。
cards.example_reading: ひだりがわ に ちゅうしゃ して ください。
cards.example_meaning: Please park on the left side.

cards.context: Confused with 左 (left). 友: bottom = 又 (one hand shaking another's). 左: bottom = 工 (work tool). 友達 (friend), 友情 (friendship).
cards.example_reading: ふるい ともだち と しょくじ した。
cards.example_meaning: I had a meal with an old friend.

cards.context: Confused visually with 草 (grass) — 草 is 早 with the 艹 (grass radical) on top. Also confused in MEANING with 速い (fast in speed). 早い is about TIMING (early); 速い is about VELOCITY.
cards.example_reading: けさ は はやく おきた。
cards.example_meaning: I woke up early this morning.

cards.context: Visually 草 = 早 + 艹 (grass crown). Mnemonic: the 'grass-crown' sits on top of 早, and grass grows EARLY in the morning. Internet slang: 草 alone means 'lol' (from www looking like grass).
cards.example_reading: にわ の くさ を ぬいた。
cards.example_meaning: I pulled the weeds in the garden.

cards.context: Confused with 持 (hold) and 特 (special). All share 寺 (temple) on the right. LEFT differs: 待 = 彳 (movement/road — wait by the path), 持 = 扌 (hand — hold), 特 = 牛 (ox — special bull).
cards.example_sentence: 駅で友達を待っている。
cards.example_reading: えき で ともだち を まって いる。
cards.example_meaning: I'm waiting for my friend at the station.

cards.context: Confused with 待 (wait) and 特 (special). 持's left = 扌 (HAND radical) — you HOLD with a hand. 持つ — to hold. 気持ち — feeling. 維持 — maintain.
cards.example_reading: かばん を もって でかけた。
cards.example_meaning: I took my bag and went out.

cards.context: Confused with 待 (wait) and 持 (hold). 特's left = 牛 (cow/ox). Mnemonic: in ancient times a 'special' cow was kept at the temple (寺). 特別 (special), 特に (especially), 特急 (limited express).
cards.example_reading: とくに もんだい は ない。

cards.context: Confused with 毎 (every) — they share the same right side. 海 has 氵 (water radical) on left, since the sea IS water. 海 = water (氵) + every (毎) — water is everywhere.
cards.example_reading: なつ に うみ で およいだ。
cards.example_meaning: I swam in the sea in summer.

cards.context: Confused with 海 (sea). 毎 is 海 without the water radical 氵. 毎日 (every day), 毎週 (every week), 毎年 (every year).
cards.example_sentence: 毎日日本語を勉強します。
cards.example_reading: まいにち にほんご を べんきょう します。

cards.context: Confused with 各 (each). 客 has 宀 (roof) on top — a guest is someone under YOUR roof. 各 has no roof. お客様, 観光客, 乗客 (passenger).
cards.example_sentence: レストランは客でいっぱいだった。
cards.example_reading: レストラン は きゃく で いっぱい だった。
cards.example_meaning: The restaurant was packed with customers.

cards.context: Confused with 客 (guest — has a roof) and 名 (name — left side looks like 夕 'evening'). 各 = no roof. 各自 (each person), 各国 (each country), 各駅 (every station).
cards.example_sentence: 各自で参加費を払ってください。
cards.example_reading: かくじ で さんかひ を はらって ください。
cards.example_meaning: Please pay your participation fee individually.

cards.context: Confused with 各 (each). 名 starts with 夕 (evening) on top; 各 starts with a different stroke. Mnemonic: in the EVENING you ask for someone's NAME at the door (mouth 口 below).
cards.example_sentence: お名前を教えてください。
cards.example_reading: お なまえ を おしえて ください。

cards.context: Confused with 比 (compare). 北's two halves FACE AWAY from each other (left/right). 比's two halves FACE the SAME direction (both look right). 北 = two people back-to-back (defending north).
cards.example_reading: ほっかいどう は さむい。

cards.context: Confused with 北 (north). 比's two parts FACE THE SAME WAY — like two people standing side by side comparing themselves. 比べる (to compare), 比較 (comparison).
cards.example_reading: ふたつ を くらべて みよう。

cards.reading: たの(しい)・ラク・ガク
cards.context: Confused with 薬 (medicine). 楽 alone = fun/music. 薬 = 楽 + 艹 (grass on top), because medicine comes from PLANTS. Memory: 'add grass to your fun and it becomes medicine.'
cards.example_sentence: 昨日のパーティーは楽しかった。
cards.example_reading: きのう の パーティー は たのしかった。

cards.context: Confused with 楽 (fun/music). 薬 = grass (艹) + music (楽) — herbal medicine was 'happy plants.' 薬局 (pharmacy), 薬を飲む (take medicine), 薬剤師 (pharmacist).
cards.example_reading: かぜぐすり を のんだ。

cards.context: Confused with 緑 (green). Both have 糸 (thread radical) on left. Right side differs: 線 has 泉 (spring/fountain) bottom; 緑 has 录 (record). 山手線 (Yamanote line), 線を引く (draw a line).
cards.example_reading: つぎ の やまのてせん に のろう。
cards.example_meaning: Let's catch the next Yamanote line train.

cards.context: Confused with 線 (line). Both have 糸 (thread). Compare: 緑 has 录 on right. 緑茶 (green tea), 新緑 (fresh greenery).
cards.example_reading: りょくちゃ を いっぱい ください。

cards.context: Confused with 複 (multiple) and 腹 (belly) — all share the right side. Left differs: 復 has 彳 (movement/road — go back), 複 has 衤 (clothing — multiple layers), 腹 has 月 (flesh — body).
cards.example_sentence: 風邪が治って復活した。
cards.example_reading: かぜ が なおって ふっかつ した。
cards.example_meaning: I recovered from my cold and revived.

cards.context: Confused with 復 (return) and 腹 (belly). 複 has 衤 (CLOTH radical) — multiple LAYERS of clothing. 複数 (plural), 複雑 (complicated), 複合 (compound).
cards.example_reading: ふくざつ な きもち だ。

cards.context: Confused with 復 (return) and 複 (multiple). 腹 has 月 (FLESH/BODY radical — used in body parts: 胃, 腕, 肝, 脳, etc.). 腹が立つ (get angry), 腹痛 (stomachache).
cards.example_sentence: 腹が減ったから何か食べたい。
cards.example_reading: はら が へった から なにか たべたい。
cards.example_meaning: I'm hungry — I want to eat something.

cards.context: Confused with 烏 (crow). 鳥 has a dot/short stroke for the EYE; 烏 doesn't (crows are so black you can't see their eyes — folk etymology). 焼き鳥 (yakitori), 野鳥 (wild bird).
cards.example_reading: にわ に ちいさな とり が きた。
cards.example_meaning: A small bird came to the garden.

cards.context: Three あつい confusables: 暑い (weather), 熱い (object), 厚い (thick). 暑 has 日 (SUN) on top — the SUN makes the WEATHER hot. Use only for AIR/WEATHER, never for a coffee cup.
cards.example_reading: きょう は ほんとう に あつい ね。

cards.context: Same reading as 暑い but for OBJECTS: hot coffee, hot bath, hot iron. 熱 has 灬 (FIRE) on the bottom. Also figurative: 熱い思い — burning passion. Never use for weather.
cards.example_sentence: このコーヒーは熱すぎる。
cards.example_reading: この コーヒー は あつ すぎる。

cards.context: Third あつい — completely different meaning. 厚い = thick (a book, slab of meat) or warm/kind (人情に厚い — full of human warmth). Pairs with 薄い (thin).
cards.example_reading: この ほん は とても あつい。

cards.context: Confused with 速い (fast). 早い = TIMING (early in the day, early to arrive). 速い = SPEED (fast car, fast runner). Mnemonic: 早 has 日 (sun) — the sun is up EARLY.
cards.example_sentence: 朝早く起きるのが苦手だ。
cards.example_reading: あさ はやく おきる の が にがて だ。
cards.example_meaning: I'm not good at waking up early.

cards.context: Confused with 早い (early). 速い = SPEED. The 辶 radical (movement) clues you in: this is motion-fast. 高速 (highway), 速度 (speed), 速報 (breaking news).
cards.example_reading: かれ は はしる の が はやい。

cards.context: Confused with 直る (be fixed). 治る = HEAL (illness, injury). 治 has 氵 (water — healing flow). 直る = REPAIR (broken object). Memory: 治 for the body, 直 for things.
cards.example_reading: かぜ が なおった。

cards.context: Same reading as 治る. 直 means 'straight/honest/direct' — fixing makes things straight again. Use for OBJECTS being repaired, mistakes being corrected.
cards.example_reading: パソコン が なおった。

cards.context: Transitive of 治る. 病気を治す — cure an illness. 風邪を治す. Doctors 治す; mechanics 直す.
cards.example_reading: くすり で びょうき を なおした。
cards.example_meaning: I cured the illness with medicine.

cards.context: Transitive of 直る. パソコンを直す — fix the PC. 間違いを直す — correct a mistake. Use 直す for everything EXCEPT illness/injury.
cards.example_sentence: 自転車を直してもらった。
cards.example_reading: じてんしゃ を なおして もらった。

cards.context: Same reading as 着る (to wear). 切 has 刂 (knife radical) on the right — CUTTING. The reading きる for both is identical, so context disambiguates.
cards.example_reading: ほうちょう で やさい を きる。
cards.example_meaning: I cut vegetables with a knife.

cards.context: Same reading as 切る (cut). 着 means 'attach/arrive.' For wearing: 着る is specifically for clothes worn over the torso. Shoes = 履く, hats = かぶる, glasses = かける.
cards.example_reading: きょう は きもの を きた。

cards.context: Most common きく. 聞 has 耳 (ear) inside the gate — listening from a doorway. Also means 'ask' (people who LISTEN can ASK). Compare 効く / 利く.
cards.example_reading: せんせい に しつもん を きいた。
cards.example_meaning: I asked the teacher a question.

cards.context: Same reading as 聞く but means EFFECT (薬が効く — the medicine works). 効果, 有効, 効率 all use 効. NOT for listening.
cards.example_reading: この くすり は よく きく。

cards.context: Third きく. Used for FACULTIES working: 気が利く (thoughtful), 目が利く (have a keen eye), 鼻が利く (have a good nose for things). Different domain from 効く (medicine).
cards.example_sentence: 彼女は本当に気が利く。
cards.example_reading: かのじょ は ほんとう に き が きく。

cards.context: 会 = meeting/gathering. Use 会う for ARRANGED meetings with people. Compare 合う (fit/match) and 遭う (encounter, usually bad).
cards.example_sentence: 明日、友達に会う予定だ。
cards.example_reading: あした、 ともだち に あう よてい だ。
cards.example_meaning: I'm planning to meet my friend tomorrow.

cards.context: Same reading as 会う but means FITTING. 服が合う — the clothes fit. 意見が合う — opinions match. 似合う — to suit (look good on). Also 〜と合う for matching things.
cards.example_sentence: このサイズはぴったり合う。
cards.example_reading: この サイズ は ぴったり あう。

cards.context: Third あう. Always NEGATIVE encounters: 事故に遭う (be in an accident), 雨に遭う (get caught in rain). 遭 has 辶 (movement) — bumping into bad things on the road.
cards.example_reading: えき で ちかん に あった。
cards.example_meaning: I had a groper incident at the station.

cards.context: Most general かえる. Change PROPERTIES/STATE: 髪型を変える (change hairstyle), 計画を変える (change plans). Compare 換える, 替える, 代える for different replacement nuances.
cards.example_reading: よてい を かえました。

cards.context: 換える = swap/exchange (currency, batteries). 円をドルに換える (exchange yen for dollars). 換 has 扌 (hand) + a swap-related right side.
cards.example_sentence: 空港で円をドルに換えた。
cards.example_reading: くうこう で えん を ドル に かえた。
cards.example_meaning: I exchanged yen for dollars at the airport.

cards.context: Replace with SAME KIND. 電球を替える (replace bulb), 着替える (change clothes). Subtle vs 換える — 替 is more 'swap one for another of same type.'
cards.example_sentence: 電池を新しいのに替えた。
cards.example_reading: でんち を あたらしい の に かえた。
cards.example_meaning: I replaced the batteries with new ones.

cards.context: 代える = substitute one thing for another in a ROLE. ピッチャーを代える (substitute the pitcher). 命に代えても — even at the cost of my life.
cards.example_reading: せんしゅ を かえた。

cards.context: Same reading as the change verbs. 帰る = go HOME specifically. Bilingual learners often confuse this with 戻る (return generally, not necessarily home).
cards.example_reading: そろそろ いえ に かえろう。
cards.example_meaning: It's about time to go home.

cards.context: Different かえる. 返 means RETURN (an object, a state). 我に返る (come to one's senses), 借金が返る (debt is returned). 返事 — reply.
cards.example_sentence: 借りた本がやっと返ってきた。
cards.example_reading: かりた ほん が やっと かえって きた。
cards.example_meaning: The book I lent finally came back.

cards.context: Multiple はかる. 計る = measure TIME or count: 時間を計る. 計 has 言 (speech, also numbers): 計画, 計算, 統計. The 'counting' family.
cards.example_sentence: タイムを計ってください。
cards.example_reading: タイム を はかって ください。

cards.context: 量 = QUANTITY (weight, volume). 体重を量る (measure body weight), 米を量る (measure rice). Compare 量 in 数量 (quantity), 大量 (large quantity).
cards.example_sentence: 体重を量ったらまた増えていた。
cards.example_reading: たいじゅう を はかったら また ふえて いた。
cards.example_meaning: When I weighed myself, I'd gained again.

cards.context: 測 = measure SPATIAL DIMENSIONS. 距離を測る (measure distance), 深さを測る (measure depth). 測 has 氵 (water) — originally about gauging water depths.
cards.example_reading: へや の ひろさ を はかった。

cards.context: General-purpose とる. Compare 撮る (photo), 採る (collect/harvest), 捕る (catch a moving target).
cards.example_sentence: その本を取ってください。
cards.example_reading: その ほん を とって ください。

cards.context: 撮 = CAPTURE on camera. 写真を撮る (take a photo), 動画を撮る (record a video). 撮 has 扌 (hand) + 最 (most). Don't write 取る for photo-taking — common error.
cards.example_sentence: 記念に写真を撮りましょう。
cards.example_reading: きねん に しゃしん を とりましょう。

cards.context: 採 = COLLECT/SELECT. 血を採る (draw blood), 採用する (hire/adopt), 採点 (grading exams). 採 has 扌 + 木 (tree, things from nature).
cards.example_sentence: 会社は新入社員を採った。
cards.example_reading: かいしゃ は しんにゅう しゃいん を とった。

cards.context: 捕 = CATCH a moving target. 魚を捕る (catch fish), 犯人を捕る (catch criminal). 捕まえる is the more common form. Compare 採る (passive collecting).
cards.example_reading: りょうし が さかな を とった。

cards.context: General-purpose みる. Compare 観る (watch carefully — movies, sports), 診る (examine medically), 視る (look/observe formally).
cards.example_reading: まど から そと を みた。
cards.example_meaning: I looked outside through the window.

cards.context: 観 = WATCHING with attention. 映画を観る (watch a film), 試合を観る (watch a match). 観 in 観光 (sightseeing), 観察 (observation). 見る is also fine — 観る is just more 'watching attentively.'
cards.example_reading: きのう、 えいが を みた。

cards.context: 診 = medical exam. 医者が患者を診る — the doctor examines the patient. Only for medical contexts. 診察 (medical exam), 診療 (medical treatment).
cards.example_reading: いしゃ に みて もらった。
cards.example_meaning: I had the doctor examine me.

cards.context: 努 = EFFORT. 努力 (effort), 努める (to strive). Use for striving toward a goal. Compare 勤める (work for company), 務める (serve in a role).
cards.example_reading: かんきょう ほご に つとめる。
cards.example_meaning: I strive to protect the environment.

cards.context: 勤 = WORK for an organization. 会社に勤める (work at a company), 通勤 (commuting), 勤務 (work duty).
cards.example_reading: ぎんこう に つとめて います。

cards.context: 務 = serve in a ROLE. 司会を務める (serve as MC), 主役を務める (play the lead). Also 義務 (duty), 任務 (mission). Function-focused.
cards.example_sentence: 結婚式の司会を務めた。
cards.example_reading: けっこんしき の しかい を つとめた。
cards.example_meaning: I served as MC for the wedding.

cards.context: Most general つくる. Use for cooking, crafting, making things. Compare 造る (build/manufacture, larger scale) and 創る (create artistically/originally).
cards.example_reading: ゆうしょく を つくった。

cards.context: 造 = construct on LARGE scale. 船を造る (build a ship), 酒を造る (brew sake), 道路を造る (build a road). Industrial/architectural feel.
cards.example_sentence: この酒蔵で日本酒を造っている。
cards.example_reading: この さかぐら で にほんしゅ を つくって いる。
cards.example_meaning: They brew sake at this brewery.

cards.context: 創 = CREATE something original/artistic. 会社を創る (found a company), 新しい文化を創る (create a new culture). 創造 (creation), 創作 (creative work).
cards.example_sentence: 新しい音楽を創りたい。
cards.example_reading: あたらしい おんがく を つくりたい。
cards.example_meaning: I want to create new music.

cards.context: Confused with 超える (exceed). 越 = physically CROSS OVER something. 山を越える (cross a mountain), 国境を越える (cross a border). 越 has 走 (run/move).
cards.example_sentence: 峠を越えると景色が広がった。
cards.example_reading: とうげ を こえる と けしき が ひろがった。
cards.example_meaning: After crossing the pass, the view opened up.

cards.context: Confused with 越える (cross). 超 = surpass an AMOUNT or LIMIT. 100人を超える (exceed 100 people), 予算を超える (exceed budget). 超 also = 'super-': 超人気, 超能力.
cards.example_reading: さんかしゃ は せん にん を こえた。

cards.context: Confused with 捜す (search for lost). 探 = search for something DESIRED. 家を探す (house hunting), 仕事を探す (job hunting). Active wanting.
cards.example_sentence: 新しい仕事を探している。
cards.example_reading: あたらしい しごと を さがして いる。
cards.example_meaning: I'm looking for a new job.

cards.context: Confused with 探す. 捜 = search for something LOST or missing. 行方不明者を捜す (search for missing person). 警察が犯人を捜す (police search for criminal). 捜査 (police investigation).
cards.example_sentence: 財布をなくして捜した。
cards.example_reading: さいふ を なくして さがした。
cards.example_meaning: I lost my wallet and searched for it.

cards.context: General あがる. 気温が上がる (temperature rises), 階段を上がる (climb stairs). Compare 揚がる (be deep-fried — same reading!).
cards.example_reading: ぶっか が あがって いる。

cards.context: Same reading as 上がる. 揚 specifically = deep-fry. 天ぷらが揚がる — tempura is fried. Also: 国旗を揚げる (raise the flag). Food-context vocabulary.
cards.example_sentence: カラッと揚がった天ぷらが美味しい。
cards.example_reading: カラッ と あがった てんぷら が おいしい。

cards.context: Confused with 初めて (for the first time). 始 = BEGIN doing something. 初 = FIRST TIME experiencing something. Same English word 'start' translates to different kanji.
cards.example_sentence: 昨日から日本語を始めた。
cards.example_reading: きのう から にほんご を はじめた。

cards.context: Confused with 始める. 初 has 刀 (knife) + 衤 (cloth) — cutting cloth was the 'first' step. Use for FIRST-TIME experiences: 初めて会う, 初めて見る. 初めまして (nice to meet you).
cards.example_sentence: 初めて日本に来ました。
cards.example_reading: はじめて にほん に きました.
cards.example_meaning: I came to Japan for the first time.

cards.context: Confused with 温かい. 暖 = ambient/atmospheric warmth — weather, rooms, hearts. 暖 has 日 (sun). 暖房 (heating), 暖冬 (warm winter), 暖かい人柄 (warm personality).
cards.example_sentence: 今日は暖かい一日だった。
cards.example_reading: きょう は あたたかい いちにち だった。

cards.context: Confused with 暖かい. 温 = warmth of OBJECTS/LIQUIDS. 温かいスープ (warm soup), 温泉 (hot spring), 体温 (body temp). 温 has 氵 (water).
cards.example_sentence: 温かいスープが体に染みる。
cards.example_reading: あたたかい スープ が からだ に しみる。
cards.example_meaning: The warm soup soothes my body.

cards.context: Confused with 固い (solid/firm) and 堅い (steady/reliable). 硬 has 石 (stone) — hard like rock. Used for physical materials.
cards.example_reading: この パン は かた すぎる。

cards.context: Confused with 硬い and 堅い. 固 = firm/solid/won't change. 固い決意 (firm resolve), 頭が固い (stubborn), 固定 (fixed). Use for abstract firmness.
cards.example_sentence: 彼は固い意志を持っている。
cards.example_reading: かれ は かたい いし を もって いる。

cards.context: Often confused with 社会 (society) — SAME kanji REVERSED. 会社 = company. 社会 = society. Order matters!
cards.example_reading: かいしゃ に ちこく した。

cards.context: Same kanji as 会社 in reverse order. 社会 = the society/the public. 社会人 (working adult/member of society), 社会保障. Don't write 会社 when you mean 社会.
cards.example_sentence: 日本の社会について学んでいる。
cards.example_reading: にほん の しゃかい に ついて まなんで いる。

cards.context: Confused with 化学 (chemistry — SAME reading!). 科学 = science (general). 化学 = chemistry specifically. Both read かがく — context disambiguates. The 学 part is identical.
cards.example_reading: かがく ぎじゅつ が はったつ した。

cards.context: Same reading as 科学. Sometimes pronounced ばけがく to disambiguate verbally. 化学 = chemistry. 化学反応 (chemical reaction), 化学者 (chemist).
cards.example_sentence: 高校で化学を勉強した。
cards.example_reading: こうこう で かがく を べんきょう した。
cards.example_meaning: I studied chemistry in high school.

cards.context: Confused with 市立 (municipal — SAME reading!). 私立 = private (個人 owned). 市立 = run by the city. Both read しりつ — colloquial pronunciation わたくしりつ (private) vs いちりつ (city) used to disambiguate.
cards.example_sentence: 私立の大学に通っている。
cards.example_reading: しりつ の だいがく に かよって いる。
